brand.name: FieldPie
brand.description: FieldPie is a B2B SaaS platform that enables businesses with field operations to manage their inspection, sales, merchandising, team management, and field control processes from a single platform.
brand.tone: Professional, technical, authoritative. Speaks as an industry expert. Clear, concise, and solution-oriented. No fluff, no hype.
pain_points_solved: Lack of real-time visibility into field operations
Poor coordination between office and field teams
differentiators: Built for the unique dynamics of field-heavy industries
Single platform covering all field operation verticals
Fast onboarding and ease of use

visual_identity.logo_description: A stylized pie chart combined with a location pin icon. The word 'Field' is written in dark gray, 'Pie' in teal/green.
visual_identity.visual_style: Modern, clean, corporate. Primary color combination of teal and dark gray. Minimalist backgrounds, strong typography, data-driven visuals.

social_media.linkedin_focus: B2B decision makers, operations managers, and company executives with field teams
social_media.instagram_focus: Brand awareness, product visualization, and industry insights
